foundation_text: Walls vs Symmetry. Asymptotes are walls. Symmetry lines cut through the centre.

6.1.variant_question: x-intercept of g in terms of p.
6.1.fatal_error: DBE says: Candidates give the y-intercept or forget 'in terms of p'.

6.2.fast_path: Walls give p and q. Point gives a.
6.2.fatal_error: DBE says: Candidates mix up the sign of p. If wall is x=-3, bracket is (x+3).

6.3.demonstration: Identify centre (p;q), identify symmetry line, describe translation.
6.3.fast_path: It's always a translation onto the line y = x + c.
6.3.fatal_error: DBE says: Candidates use vague language like 'shift it' or move it onto an asymptote instead of a symmetry line.
answer_book_layout: Translate g by ... units to lie on the symmetry line
6.3.hack: Name the move so g lands on the symmetry line.
